assigned_subskill: combining two ratios through a shared variable
question_bn: যদি x : y = 2 : 3 এবং y : z = 5 : 7 হয়; তবে x : y : z =?
solution_steps: The shared variable y has ratio entries 3 and 5.
Multiply x : y = 2 : 3 by 5 to get 10 : 15.
Multiply y : z = 5 : 7 by 3 to get 15 : 21.
Join at the common value of y to obtain x : y : z = 10 : 15 : 21.
